name:
The Green O
All Inclusive
insider_take: Montana's first luxury glamping resort sits on 37,000 pristine acres where the Rocky Mountain Front meets the Great Plains - a dramatic landscape that's pure Big Sky magic.
whats_special: This all-inclusive eco-luxury retreat features safari-style canvas tents with heated floors, private decks, and unobstructed views of the Continental Divide. You're staying on a working ranch where bison roam freely and the night sky offers some of the darkest stargazing in the lower 48 states.
pro_tip: Book during late spring or early fall when wildlife is most active - you might spot elk, deer, and even mountain goats from your tent's private deck.
dont_miss: The guided ranch tours to see the 1,000+ head of bison herd, fly-fishing on the pristine Blackfoot River (yes, from "A River Runs Through It"), and the nightly campfire experiences with s'mores under Montana's legendary star-filled skies.
pros: All-inclusive luxury experience with premium amenities
Exclusive boutique property with personalized service
cons: Remote location may require additional travel planning
Limited dining variety due to boutique size
